description.zh:
挂载点描述信息。

长度为0~100个字符。
description.en:
The description of the mount point.

The description must be 0 to 100 characters in length.

description.zh:
待挂载文件存储 HDFS 版文件系统的ECS实例ID。 

添加多个ECS实例ID时，使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多支持100个ECS实例ID。
description.en:
The ECS instance IDs to attach the Apsara File Storage for HDFS file system.

Separate multiple ECS instance IDs with commas. You can specify up to 100 ECS instance IDs.
